instructions_to_main_agent: Remove `Mini` and `Dot` components. Create cleaner, less boxed-in structures like `ListItem` and `Callout`.
Apply `h-[100dvh]` and strictly ensure no scrolling via `overflow-hidden`.
Implement the dark theme using inline classes: `bg-[#0b1120]`, `text-slate-300`, `border-slate-800`.
Use proper flexbox (`flex-1`, `mt-auto`) to distribute vertical space inside the cards rather than letting text cram to the top.
